name: Shizuhara Miyu
source:
Another third-year student. She is a talented pianist, and hopes to become a concert performer one day. She has a frail constitution and is often sick. Because of this, Miyu's only friends are [url=https://vndb.org/c4694]Kaho[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c4700]Ryou[/url].

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crescendo_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
